title: Man accused of filming kids at Frog Pond facing more than 60 new charges, officials say
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Crime Mark Sullivan, of Brockton, has been held on $250,000 bail since allegedly attempting to film children using smart glasses in August.

title: An award-winning homebrewer is opening a brewery in Davis Square
author: Ling Zi
bullets: Restaurants A data scientist plans to experiment with low-ABV IPAs and new hop products at his first brewery.
Courtesy By Ling Zi September 15, 2026 | 11:32 AM 2 minutes to read Somerville’s booming brewery scene will soon see a new addition in the heart of Davis Square.

Slated to open in late spring of 2027, Curiosity Brewing will turn a vacant former auto body shop into an all day cafe and brewery, serving coffee and snacks during the day, and hazy New England IPAs at night.
